answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 31813 Country: India Title: My baby is of eight month and she stop breastfeeding since she was 1 month old and my wife stop milking since then but some time if squeezed hard with hands some drop of milk comes out of her breast. Question: My baby is of eight month and she stop breastfeeding since she was 1 month old and my wife stop milking since then but some time if squeezed hard with hands some drop of milk comes out of her breast so is it permissible for me to suck my wife breast during intercourse ? and unknowingly if i swallow some milk will my marriage nullified ? Answer ID: 31813 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 687/576/B=1432) You shall be sinful for drinking haram if one drop of milk entered into your throat while sucking the breast. However, your nikah will not break. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
